transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Hi Devon, I'm Sipho. Before the provider joins, tell me what brought you here.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Work's been brutal. I'm wired all the time, sleeping badly. Read that this helps with burnout.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Your intake put your depression score at 6 and anxiety at 5, which are both on the low side. Does that match?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I mean, I wouldn't say I'm depressed. I'm just fried.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: I want to ask about alcohol. Your answers came out at 19 on the screening, which is high.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I have a few after work. Everyone does in my line of work. It's not a problem, I just unwind.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: And you noted a hospital stay in 2024?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Pancreatitis. They said it was probably the drinking but it cleared up.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Thanks for being straight with me. Let me get the provider.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Devon, hi. I've gone through everything with Sipho. I don't think this is the right treatment for you at the moment.

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Why not? I thought this was for people like me.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Two reasons. Your depression and anxiety scores are low enough that this isn't likely to be the right tool. And with the amount you're drinking, plus the pancreatitis, I'm not comfortable adding ketamine into the mix.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Not necessarily. I'd like you to talk to your primary care doctor about the drinking and the sleep. If things change, you're welcome to come back.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: [note to file] AUDIT 19 with prior alcohol-related pancreatitis and clear minimisation. Declining today. He was irritated - if he contacts support, do not relitigate the clinical reasoning over text, offer a call.

notes.clinical_summary: 34M presenting with occupational burnout. PHQ 6 / GAD 5 - below threshold. AUDIT 19, prior alcohol-related pancreatitis 2024, minimises intake. Not appropriate for VLD ketamine at this time.
notes.plan: Not approved. No prescription. Recommend primary care review of alcohol use and sleep. May reapply if circumstances change. Handle follow-up contact by phone, not text.
